name: coh
description: CoH (Code of Harness) routes coding agents through repository-owned guidance and collects bounded, report-only validation evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and route repository harness work
interface.longDescription: Combine one explicit CoH Bootstrap Skill with opt-in task routing and report-only validation receipt collection. Repository files remain the authority, and lifecycle hooks never edit Guide, Fact Map, AGENTS.md, tests, or CI.
capabilities: Construct a recoverable READY or BLOCKED Harness Model
Route opted-in tasks to repository-owned guidance
defaultPrompt: Use $coh to assess this repository's agent harness.
